skill.name: webhook-development
skill.description: Implement webhook systems for event-driven integration with retry logic, signature verification, and delivery guarantees. Use when creating event notification systems, integrating with external services, or building event-driven architectures.

generated_query: I'm building an order management system for an online store and need to send real-time notifications to external services (like shipping providers, accounting software, and CRM) whenever new orders are created or updated. Each external service has its own endpoint URL and expects the event payload in a specific format with a signature for verification. The system must handle temporary failures: if an external service is down, the notification should be retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff, and after that the failed event should be saved to a dead-letter queue for manual inspection. Additionally, I want to be able to register new webhook subscriptions dynamically through an API, allowing each subscriber to specify which events they’re interested in and to set their own secret for HMAC signing. Can you help me design and implement this webhook delivery service, including the event schema, subscription management endpoints, queue processing with retries, signature verification, and dead-letter handling? Provide the code and configuration for a Node.js service using Express and Bull.

Reducing retries to 2 and removing exponential backoff means the service cannot meet the requirement of up to 5 retries with exponential backoff for temporary failures.
Prevents subscribers from setting their own secret, violating the requirement for custom HMAC signing secrets per subscriber.
